messages:
zoe: Quick thread to plan the Prompt Challenge launch tied to the next webinar. Idea: 30-minute build challenge + curated prompt templates + small token prize for winners.

sam: love the hands-on angle. audience = developers who tried the API but didn't ship.

irene: timeline? we have two weeks before the webinar slot.

zoe: timeline = prep week + launch week. assets: landing, 5 templates, 1 walkthrough video, social 4 creatives.

mike: routing note: signups should get immediate template pack + 'challenge' cohort tag. we'll run a 3-email cadence: confirm, tips, winners.

rachel (growth): incentive split: top 10 winners get 200 tokens each + feature shoutout. also A/B test two CTAs: "Start the challenge" vs "Get templates + tokens".

analytics-bot: Created experiment EXP-2026-PROMPTCH-01, tagging enabled.

sam: Measurement plan (suggested): 1) registration -> attendance conversion 2) attendee -> first 5 calls within 48h 3) 7-day retention 4) % who use template pack. baseline numbers in spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/prompt-challenge-kpis

irene: benchmark narrative for PR/ops: emphasize "time-to-first-feature" metric. show median time from signup->first successful call.

mike: routing rule (pseudo):
```
when signup.source == 'prompt_challenge' {
  grant_templates('challenge_pack')
  cohort.add('prompt-challenge-mar-2026')
  grant.tokens(100)
}
```

rachel (growth): For A/B, Variant A = CTA focus on templates (nudge copy: "Build faster with curated prompts"), Variant B = CTA focus on tokens (nudge copy: "Start with 100 free tokens"). split = 40/40/20 (control/variants/holdout).

zoe: social cadence: 3 posts pre-webinar (teaser, tutorials sneak, live reminder), live demo clip after, winners post 3 days later.

sam: copy drafts inbound:
- teaser: "Ship an AI flow in 30 minutes — join our Prompt Challenge."
- reminder: "Seats limited: challenge + live walkthrough + templates."
- winners: "Meet the Prompt Challenge winners + see their builds."

irene: need landing wireframe + eventbrite link. I can put a simple form capturing github handle + use case.

analytics-bot: Cohort prompt-challenge-mar-2026 created and linked to EXP-2026-PROMPTCH-01.

mike: KPI targets for the benchmark: 500 registrations, 40% attendance, 30% of attendees run >=5 API calls in 48h, lift in 7-day retention +15% vs baseline.

rachel (growth): I'll make the dashboard with cohort funnels and latency breakdowns per template. want to see if certain templates correlate with lower median token consumption.

zoe: blockers?

sam: design for landing (CTA variants) and final templates. i'll ping design.

irene: ops: webinar host confirmed. will set up recording + follow-up automation.

mike: tagging note: mark experiment UTM params: utm_campaign=prompt-challenge-mar2026 utm_source=social.

zoe: sweet. owners: zoe(overall), rachel(growth + analysis), irene(ops), sam(templates), mike(tracking). deadline: assets ready by Mon 10am PT. check-in Fri 11am.

rachel (growth): added calendar + created the A/B matrix doc.

analytics-bot: Reminder set: check-in Fri 11:00 PT.

zoe: thanks team :tada:
